title: 第17章 麻雀喳喳修炼法门第18章 巡山小队众妖本性
content_zh:
与麻雀妖走了一段路后，莫凡算是终于明白对方为何会叫“喳喳”这么独特的名字了。
因为这一路行来，他的耳朵几乎就没清净过，关键是喳喳的话颇有些颠三倒四主次不分，也就是所谓的废话。
“对了，来宝，你可知道哥哥的大名？”喳喳突然问道。
“哥，这已经是你第三次问这个问题了……”
莫凡脸皮微微抽动，颇有些无语。
在他看来这喳喳和月光宝盒里的那个唐僧有得一拼，实在是太能喳了。
“呃，是吗？俺怎么不记得了，不过没关系，你就再记一次哥哥的大名好了！”
小麻雀在莫凡肩上歪着头，举起一边的翅膀，一脸嘚瑟的说道：“听好了，俺的名字叫喳喳！是当初妖王爷爷给取的，妖王爷爷说俺是咱们黑风山最能说的，因此给取了这个无比好听的名字！”
“你可记住了？！”
莫凡强忍着一把抓住这小麻雀狠揍一顿的冲动，露出一丝笑颜道：“记住了，渣渣！”
“嗯，不错，不错！”
“对了，刚才俺说到哪儿了？”
喳喳突然一偏脑袋，似乎在努力回想着刚才说的话。
莫凡见状心中一动，说道：“刚才渣渣哥你说到俺们妖怪修行的事了。”
“哦，对对对，俺们妖怪修行这件事乃重中之重，俺倒是要与兄弟你好好唠唠……”
喳喳不疑有他，当即一本正经地说道：“俺们妖怪修行通常分为两类途径。”
“哪两类？”
莫凡闻言心中顿时就激动了起来。
他不远千里来这黑风山是为了什么？
还不就是为了这妖怪修炼法门么？

现在他即将得知，自然心情大好。
“一类是吞吃灵药，这一点来宝你应该是知道的。”
莫凡听到这话一愣，连忙又追问道：“那另一类呢？”
“别急别急，先听哥哥好好给你讲讲。”
“这世间灵药也分三六九等，总的来说可分为天、地、玄、黄、四个等级的灵药，而每一级灵药则又细分为上中下三品。
四类灵药中以天级灵药为最，黄级灵药垫底。
可即便是黄级灵药那也是俺们这些小妖一辈子都难得到的稀珍了。
俺曾听老爷提及过，一株完整的黄级下品灵药就足够让俺们这些小妖蜕变出灵身，跻身妖丁境！
当然，在黄级灵药之下还有一种不入流的灵药，却是俺们这些小妖最有希望寻到的。”
“不入流？”莫凡眉头微蹙。
“不错，想必来宝你已经明白了。
不入流就是俺们这些小妖在化妖时所吞食的灵药。
虽然在灵药中属于不入流的一类，可却也远胜凡俗草药，因此自有一些灵气蕴含其中，也正是这一部分灵气供应了俺们化妖所需。
对了，日后俺们每三年都必须上交一株不入流灵药交给黑子老爷。
这是整个黑风山的规矩，据说是妖王爷爷定下的，说是什么保护费。”喳喳歪着小脑袋说道。
保护费？
莫凡听到这话顿时一瞪眼，这特么做了妖怪也还需要交保护费？
果然，天下乌鸦一般黑啊！
在这个世界不仅仅是人族可怕，就连妖族也都这么无情！
“如果三年时间到了，交不出不入流灵药该咋办？”莫凡好奇问道。

“嘿嘿，好办，交不出灵药，那就必须前往人族地界抓回一人类来抵偿！”喳喳笑道。
“那这个貌似挺简单啊！”
莫凡闻言点点头，妖怪吃人在他看来还算正常，而且做妖怪的要抓一个人类，还不是手到擒来么？
content_en:
After walking with the sparrow demon for a while, Mo Fan finally understood why the sparrow demon had such a unique name as "Chacha".
Because along the way, his ears have hardly been cleared. The key is that his chatter is quite confusing and indifferent, which is the so-called nonsense.
"By the way, Lai Bao, do you know my brother's name?" Chat Chat suddenly asked.
"Brother, this is the third time you have asked this question..."
Mo Fan's face twitched slightly and he was quite speechless.
In his opinion, this chatter is as good as the Tang Monk in the Moonlight Box. He is really good at chattering.
"Uh, really? Why don't I remember it, but it doesn't matter, just remember my brother's name again!"
The little sparrow tilted its head on Mo Fan's shoulder, raised one of its wings, and said with a stern expression: "Listen up, my name is Cha Cha! It was given to me by Grandpa Demon King. Grandpa Demon King said that I am the best speaker in Black Wind Mountain, so I gave him this extremely nice name!"
"Do you remember?!"
Mo Fan resisted the urge to grab the little sparrow and beat it up, and said with a smile: "Remember, scumbag!"
"Well, not bad, not bad!"
"By the way, where did I say just now?"
Chatter suddenly tilted his head, as if he was trying to remember what he just said.
When Mo Fan saw this, his heart moved and he said, "Brother Zhazha, you just talked about our monster cultivation."
"Oh, yes, yes, our monster cultivation is a top priority. I want to have a good chat with you, brother..."
Chat Cha did not doubt that he was there, and immediately said seriously: "We monster cultivation is usually divided into two categories."
"What two categories?"
Mo Fan immediately became excited when he heard this.
Why did he come all the way to Black Wind Mountain?
Isn't it just for this monster to practice?
Now that he is about to find out, he is naturally in a good mood.
"One is to swallow the elixir. You should know this, Laibao."
Mo Fan was stunned when he heard this, and quickly asked: "What about the other type?"
"Don't be anxious, don't be anxious, let me explain it to you first."
"Elixirs in this world are also divided into three, six or nine grades. Generally speaking, they can be divided into four levels of elixirs: heaven, earth, xuan, and yellow. Each level of elixirs is further divided into three levels: upper, middle, and lower.
Among the four types of elixirs, heaven-level elixirs are the best, and yellow-level elixirs are at the bottom.
But even yellow-level elixirs are rare and rare for little monsters like us to obtain in our lifetime.
I once heard the master mention that a complete yellow-level low-grade elixir is enough to transform little demons like us into spiritual bodies and ascend to the realm of demons!
Of course, there is an inferior elixir under the yellow-level elixir, but it is the one we little monsters have the best hope of finding. "
"Not popular?" Mo Fan frowned slightly.
"Yes, I believe you already understand Laibao.
Buruiu is the elixir that little demons like us swallow when transforming into demons.
Although it is not popular among elixirs, it is far better than ordinary herbs, so it contains some spiritual energy, and it is this part of spiritual energy that provides what we need to transform into monsters.
By the way, from now on, we must hand over an inferior elixir to Master Heizi every three years.
This is the rule of the entire Black Wind Mountain. It is said that it was set by the Demon King Grandpa, and it is said to be some kind of protection fee. "Chacha said, tilting his little head.
Protection fee?
Mo Fan immediately glared when he heard this. He is a monster and still needs to pay protection fees?
Sure enough, the world is as black as crows!
In this world, not only the human race is scary, but also the demon race is so ruthless!
"What should I do if three years are up and I can't deliver the elixir?" Mo Fan asked curiously.
"Hehe, it's easy to handle. If you can't hand over the elixir, then you have to go to the human realm to capture a human being to make up for it!" Chatter laughed.
"Then this seems pretty simple!"
Mo Fan nodded when he heard this. In his opinion, it is normal for monsters to eat people.If a monster wants to capture a human being, isn't it easy to do so?
